units.source_text: 紫夫人一向闭居深宫，四时佳节，朝夕都有游宴佳兴，早已耳熏目染了。

en.t: Lady Murasaki had long lived secluded deep within the palace, and through the festivals of the four seasons and the pleasures of morning and evening banquets, she had already grown thoroughly familiar with such elegant amusements.

units.source_text: 但出门游山玩水，却是少有机会。

en.t: But she had rarely had the chance to go out and enjoy mountains and waters.

units.source_text: 何况此次离去京都，远游他乡，更是她从来未曾经历之事，因此深感兴味，不胜欣喜。

en.t: All the more so, leaving the capital this time and traveling far to another place was something she had never experienced before, so she found it deeply fascinating and was overjoyed.
